races.name: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Fillies' Group 2)
races.verdict:
LIBERTANGO had recent Phoenix Stakes winner Sun Goddess behind in second when landing the Albany at Royal Ascot so that form looks strong and she's taken to make amends for a short-priced reversal at Newmarket. Owner Jaber Abdullah has won this race 5 times (also had the second last year) and his wide-margin Leopardstown maiden scorer Star of State is feared most ahead of Wild Blossom, whose yard has won this twice since 2019, and Ruby Moon, who was 2 lengths behind the selection at Newmarket.

  1. LIBERTANGO (IRE)
  2. STAR OF STATE (IRE)
  3. WILD BLOSSOM (IRE)

races.name: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SUN GODDESS could have been handed a more beneficial draw but Aidan O'Brien's Phoenix Stakes heroine is a clear standout on form and should still prove capable of landing this valuable prize. Satellite of Love can go close in his bid to provide Clive Cox with a fourth consecutive win in this race, while top-weight Tokaido is also highly respected after a pair of Group wins in France.

  1. SUN GODDESS (IRE)
  2. SATELLITE OF LOVE (IRE)
  3. TOKAIDO

races.name: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
Preference is for CENTIGRADE, who beat a couple of now smart types on his second start at 2 yrs and returned from a lengthy absence with an impressive victory at Southwell. He gets the vote on handicap debut ahead of last year's winner of the race Bullet Point, while Hawksbill shaped well at Glorious Goodwood and is another to consider, along with The Lost King.

  1. CENTIGRADE (IRE)
  2. BULLET POINT
  3. HAWKSBILL

races.name: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Fillies' And Mares' Group 1)
races.verdict:
If KALPANA can reproduce the high-class form she achieved when winning the King George she'll be a very tough nut to crack. Last year's winner Minnie Hauk is a lot better than she showed in the King George and will likely get much closer here but it could still be that the chief threat comes from progressive 3-y-o Johanna Walsh, so impressive in the Irish Oaks last time.

  1. KALPANA
  2. JOHANNA WALSH (IRE)
  3. MINNIE HAUK (IRE)

races.name: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for quite a few of these, but MORROPHORE has looked a pattern-class performer in the making, winning 3 of her 5 handicap starts, so John & Thady Gosden's 5-y-o can take this step up in class in her stride on reappearance. This more galloping track should suit A La Prochaine, so she heads up the opposition, with Without Prejudice and Summerson a pair who fall into the 'could be anything' category.

  1. MORROPHORE (FR)
  2. A LA PROCHAINE (FR)
  3. WITHOUT PREJUDICE (IRE)

races.name: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery
races.verdict:
There's plenty to suggest that MIA FANTASIA is a well-handicapped horse, and he looks the pick at the weights in an ultra-competitive renewal. Rising Tiger did finish ahead of the selection earlier in the season and could be the main danger for connections with an excellent record in this race. Most of the likely front runners are drawn high, which may also bring Weleyff and Revels into the mix. Mirzimaan completes the shortlist.

  1. MIA FANTASIA (IRE)
  2. RISING TIGER (IRE)
  3. WELEYFF (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A wide open finale. The unexposed STARLIGHT LASS displayed a taking turn of foot when going in at Yarmouth and is fancied to take this step up in class in her stride now going handicapping for her top yard. Hat-trick seeking Tryst rates a big threat though, while Oolong Poobong is weighted to go close too now freshened up after a break. Progressive types Secret History and Zooella complete the shortlist.

  1. STARLIGHT LASS
  2. TRYST (IRE)
  3. OOLONG POOBONG (IRE)

races.name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SO LOVELY has made a highly encouraging start to her career and with further improvement on the cards, Aidan O'Brien's filly is fancied to make it third time lucky. There are a host of well-bred newcomers in opposition however, Miss Hong Kong, Zenith Blaze and Fair Say to name 3, and the market will no doubt prove informative with regards to their chances.

  1. SO LOVELY (USA)
  2. MISS HONG KONG (IRE)
  3. ZENITH BLAZE

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
BANKS OF THE BOYNE ran well enough despite not looking to benefit from the return to 6f at the Curragh over the weekend and his previous form at Galway and Fairyhouse would make him the one to beat granted he copes with the quick turnaround. Joseph O'Brien's newcomer Togetherwearefree merits respect on debut, with The Green Helmet also on the shortlist.

  1. BANKS OF THE BOYNE (IRE)
  2. TOGETHERWEAREFREE (IRE)
  3. THE GREEN HELMET (IRE)

races.name: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
races.verdict:
FAOLADH may have got off lightly with a 3 lb rise for Galway given that the second has gone in since. Last year's winner Altimara took a step back in the right direction when fifth at Naas last time and could be primed for another bold bid in this race. La La Lucrative, who wasn't far behind the selection at Galway, Bear Right and low-mileage 3-y-o Mr Perth are a few of many others who could have a say in this competitive handicap.

  1. FAOLADH (IRE)
  2. ALTIMARA (IRE)
  3. BEAR RIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
The extra furlong will only benefit fast-improving WYMAN, who may well extend his winning sequence. Joseph O'Brien has a strong hand, with Group 1-entered Cannes particularly interesting in a race stacked with potential improvers.

  1. WYMAN (IRE)
  2. CANNES (IRE)
  3. PIAZZA SAN MARCO (USA)

races.name: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
races.verdict:
PARTY DRESS shaped as if still in good form at this course last time and, having dropped to a career-low mark, she could be ready to get back to winning ways. Pavilion End hasn't been beaten far on his last 2 starts and is feared most, ahead of Celtic Druid.

  1. PARTY DRESS (IRE)
  2. PAVILION END
  3. CELTIC DRUID (IRE)

races.name: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
races.verdict:
GODDESS OF WAR shaped well when an initial fourth at Gowran and with that form having been well advertised since she can build on it and get off the mark. Both Holy Lettuce and Port Arthur also have the form to play a part and command plenty of respect, while Joseph O'Brien's newcomer Scorcher's Son is another to consider, especially if the market vibes are positive.

  1. GODDESS OF WAR (SAF)
  2. HOLY LETTUCE (IRE)
  3. PORT ARTHUR (IRE)

races.name: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
TACHOS and Bella Colombia are weighted to finish much closer than they did here 2 weeks ago. Dermot Weld's mare should get a more efficient trip from stall 1 this time and may just be able to reverse that form with the addition of first-time headgear.

  1. TACHOS (IRE)
  2. BELLA COLOMBIA (IRE)
  3. MALLAVELLY (IRE)

races.name: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
HARMANI has achieved the most of these on the Flat as things stand and, having joined a quality NH yard, he's taken to make a successful start to life over hurdles. Sea of Dubka showed improved form to open her account on the Flat at Down Royal last month and is the type to make a hurdler, while Minella Buoy can put his experience to good use.

  1. HARMANI (IRE)
  2. SEA OF DUBKA (IRE)
  3. MINELLA BUOY

races.name: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GINO BELLA is on an upward curve, having won her last two starts at Cork under positive rides, and she is taken to shrug off another rise and complete the hat-trick in a race lacking confirmed front runners. Autumn Twist is a C&D winner who chased home subsequent Galway Hurdle winner Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown when last seen in this sphere and rates the main danger if able to reproduce that form, while Fiveonefive did well to win at Galway last time and should be thereabouts.

  1. GINO BELLA (IRE)
  2. AUTUMN TWIST (IRE)
  3. FIVEONEFIVE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
DIAMOND DU BERLAIS' stamina for this far isn't set in stone but she's very much the one to beat on these advantageous terms so it's worth risking that she'll see it out. Local News is going the right way and is feared most.

  1. DIAMOND DU BERLAIS (FR)
  2. LOCAL NEWS (IRE)
  3. BROTHER WALFRID (IRE)

races.name: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
Not the easiest race to assess but it could be worth siding with Gordon Elliott's point/hurdles winner LEMMY CAUTION to prove the ace of the pack here and make a successful start over fences. Affinity Rock rates a big threat but could have to settle for runner-up spot once more, while Ballystone also needs considering if, as expected, building on his recent Galway fourth.

  1. LEMMY CAUTION (FR)
  2. AFFINITY ROCK (IRE)
  3. BALLYSTONE (IRE)

races.name: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
LADIES WELL has made a bright start to her chasing career, winning over C&D before bumping into one at Roscommon last time. She looks sure to go close if repeating either of those efforts with the tongue strap back on. Western Model won off a 3 lb higher mark over hurdles and rates the chief danger back over fences, while Kilkee Bay should appreciate the drop back in trip and can reverse recent form with the inconsistent Cullenwaine.

  1. LADIES WELL (IRE)
  2. WESTERN MODEL (IRE)
  3. KILKEE BAY (IRE)

races.name: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MINERS BRIDGE won here over hurdles and should benefit from his recent return at Cork, so he is taken to capitalise on an attractive mark now back over fences. Gaelic Des Chastys was a model of consistency last season and has gone well fresh in the past, so rates the main danger, while Burru remains fairly treated on the pick of his hurdling efforts.

  1. MINERS BRIDGE (IRE)
  2. GAELIC DES CHASTYS (FR)
  3. BURRU (IRE)

races.name: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
FEMME MAGNIFIQUE is thriving for David Harry Kelly and a 9 lb rise for last month's C&D win looks well within range. Piccolo Player and Ballybrittas head the opposition.

  1. FEMME MAGNIFIQUE (IRE)
  2. PICCOLO PLAYER (IRE)
  3. BALLYBRITTAS (IRE)

races.name: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh Flat Race
races.verdict:
IRON SWORD is the narrow form pick on the strength of his debut form so he gets the nod to make it third time lucky. Killeedy showed ability despite being caught wider than ideal on her initial outing over C&D last month and is an obvious threat, especially with her top yard going notably well with its bumper horses at present. The Last Line pushed an exciting prospect close first time up at Cork in July 2024, but his subsequent absence is a concern.

  1. IRON SWORD (FR)
  2. KILLEEDY (IRE)
  3. THE LAST LINE (IRE)

races.name: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MINKAAS had been off for 11 weeks prior to her close third at Yarmouth so it's possible she'll come on again and she gets the vote ahead of the class-dropping Grey Tamam and George Scott's Elpeeare. James Fanshawe has had a few first-time-out winners this year so Scoot Away needs checking out in the betting.

  1. MINKAAS (IRE)
  2. GREY TAMAM (IRE)
  3. ELPEEARE (IRE)

races.name: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
TIE A NAVYRIBBON ought to find this a good deal easier than the Sweet Solera and is selected to make the most of the 4 lb she receives from Catterick debut scorer Missouri Waltz. George Scott debutante Veloria could also play a prominent role if the betting speaks for her.

  1. TIE A NAVYRIBBON
  2. MISSOURI WALTZ (IRE)
  3. VELORIA (IRE)

races.name: Come Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
It's hard to get away from VENETIAN LION, who opened his account on second handicap start at Nottingham recently and William Haggas' 3-y-o is open to further improvement. Mertoun has proved a different beast since sent handicapping upped to 1m, so he looks the one to give the selection most to think about, with Calyxoh rounding off the shortlist.

  1. VENETIAN LION
  2. MERTOUN (FR)
  3. CALYXOH (IRE)

races.name: National Stud Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for ROUND THE TABLE who has won both starts since his promising debut, creating a good impression when kicking clear at Doncaster last time before just holding on in the end. He can do better still as he heads into handicaps and gets the vote ahead of the in-form First Officer, with Race To The Stars also one to note.

  1. ROUND THE TABLE (IRE)
  2. FIRST OFFICER (IRE)
  3. RACE TO THE STARS (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
Chloe Lyons has struck up an excellent partnership with CHERRY COBBLER and given the margins involved over C&D last week, he's wisely turned out under a penalty. Cancan In The Rain and Mr Writer head the opposition.

  1. CHERRY COBBLER
  2. CANCAN IN THE RAIN (IRE)
  3. MR WRITER (IRE)

races.name: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SILBLING RIVELRY ran well despite losing ground at the start when second here last time and she can build on that effort to record a fifth career success. The biggest threat could come from Jack Langley as he drops back down in trip, while last-time-out C&D winner Society Girl is capable of another bold bid

  1. SIBLING RIVELRY
  2. JACK LANGLEY
  3. SOCIETY GIRL

races.name: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
races.verdict:
NIFFLER fits the bill of a typical Sir Mark Prescott improver, and he appeals most in an ordinary low-grade handicap. Fleur De Mer is feared most off her slipping mark, with Forever Perfect and Jedhi Knight also worth considering.

  1. NIFFLER (GER)
  2. FLEUR DE MER (IRE)
  3. FOREVER PERFECT

races.name: Trusted Betting Site Reviews gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
QUEEN'S HAME should have more to offer on the back of her Nottingham success and is preferred to fellow recent winner Star of Commala.

  1. QUEEN'S HAME
  2. STAR OF COMMALA (IRE)
  3. ROCCAPINA

races.name: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SPIRITED GESTURE looked good on her Newmarket debut and should make it 2-2, likely at the expense of Pontefract scorer Angel In My Heart unless the betting speaks in the favour of well-bred Hugo Palmer newcomer Rubyroo.

  1. SPIRITED GESTURE
  2. ANGEL IN MY HEART (IRE)
  3. RUBYROO (IRE)

races.name: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery
races.verdict:
INFLUENCER MAN took another step forward when gaining a first success at Carlisle last week and with that form working out well he can defy a 6 lb penalty here. The progressive Star People appeals as the one to chase him home ahead of May Bee In Profit and This Moment.

  1. INFLUENCER MAN (IRE)
  2. STAR PEOPLE (FR)
  3. MAY BEE IN PROFIT

races.name: Knox Hydrate Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but veteran COPPER KNIGHT has slipped back down to 2 lb below his last winning mark so is fancied to bag another C&D success. Azuinthejungle is feared most in his bid for a four-timer, although Little Mi Mi, Castan and Too Much can all play a prominent role in this competitive sprint too.

  1. COPPER KNIGHT (IRE)
  2. AZUINTHEJUNGLE
  3. LITTLE MI MI (IRE)

races.name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
races.verdict:
GEMINI STAR made a promising start for Julia and Shelley Birkett when runner-up in a big-field Thirsk handicap on her return in May and is weighted to go one better here. Operation Gimcrack is feared most on the back of a narrow reverse at Doncaster, although Mount Ruapehu, Desert Master and Wait For It also need factoring into this very open sprint.

  1. GEMINI STAR (IRE)
  2. OPERATION GIMCRACK (IRE)
  3. MOUNT RUAPEHU (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Speed looks to be INGLEWOOD's chief asset so this track will suit her and on the evidence of her Thirsk performance 2 weeks ago, she's up to dominating these. Birkacre Brow is probably the chief threat unless a newcomer is above average, with Adelaides Turn perhaps the pick.

  1. INGLEWOOD
  2. BIRKACRE BROW
  3. ADELAIDES TURN

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Joseph O'Brien's ONE NUMBER sets a good standard for a race of this nature judged on the pick of his exploits in Ireland and with the return to 1m/switch to all-weather both potential positives, he earns the vote to leave behind a lesser effort at Galway with first-time cheekpieces now reached for. Charlie Appleby's strike rate with 2-y-o newcomers is an enviable one and his Royal Acclamation commands obvious respect on racecourse bow. Fellow newcomer Blueabad may emerge next best.

  1. ONE NUMBER (USA)
  2. ROYAL ACCLAMATION
  3. BLUEABAD

races.name: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
races.verdict:
OCEAN FORCE is a lightly-raced gelding who hasn't been seen to best effect in qualifying for a mark and could well transform now switched to handicaps for shrewd connections. Both Bajan Bandit and Dandy Khan have contested better races than this lately and are feared most.

  1. OCEAN FORCE (IRE)
  2. BAJAN BANDIT
  3. DANDY KHAN (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
GUNFIGHTER (in the absence of stablemate Split Elevens) looks the way to go having not been seen to best effect at Wolverhampton 3 weeks ago. 3-y-os Powder Monkey and Paranjape could be the biggest dangers.

  1. GUNFIGHTER (IRE)
  2. POWDER MONKEY (IRE)
  3. PARANJAPE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
races.verdict:
PENNINE WAY is going the right way with progressive efforts at Wolverhampton and Brighton recently and this could be an ideal opportunity for her to get off the mark from a handy stall. Fuseboard isn't so well drawn but beat a subsequent winner with ease last time and could be a threat back up in grade, while Apex Star won't be far away if giving his running.

  1. PENNINE WAY
  2. FUSEBOARD
  3. APEX STAR (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
FIORELLA PRINCESS has been absent since running below her best at Nottingham in the spring but she starts out for a new yard who excel with sprinting types and, having proven her effectiveness when fresh earlier in her career, she could well be worth siding with back on the all-weather. Sea Her Excel has landed 2 of her last 3 starts on turf and is feared, along with class-dropping top weight Over Spiced.

  1. FIORELLA PRINCESS (IRE)
  2. SEA HER EXCEL
  3. OVER SPICED

races.name: Racing TV Club Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PORCUPINE BANK holds the clear form edge over rival Fine Thing and with this longer trip likely to hold no fears Gordon Elliott's 4-y-o is fancied to quickly resume winning ways from Dan Skelton's Uttoxeter scorer.

  1. PORCUPINE BANK (IRE)
  2. FINE THING

races.name: Happy 70th Birthday Helen Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NOTNOWLINDA has a fine record fresh and could be the answer in a tight handicap. Torrent and Rebel Tribesman both look credible dangers.

  1. NOTNOWLINDA (IRE)
  2. TORRENT
  3. REBEL TRIBESMAN (IRE)

races.name: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN COOL left the impression he would have finished closer still but for losing momentum at the last when third behind Sir Tivo here over shorter 32 days ago and, with the Jennie Candlish yard continuing in fine form, he's fancied to emerge victorious on this occasion. Crebilly is potentially well handicapped on the pick of his old chase form and is a threat. Parisencore completes the shortlist back at a more suitable trip.

  1. CAPTAIN COOL (IRE)
  2. CREBILLY (IRE)
  3. SIR TIVO (FR)

races.name: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DUNKERQUE was denied the 5-timer by a much less-exposed rival at Cartmel last time and can swiftly resume winning ways. Samuel Spade should pose a bigger threat than Krak granted his suspect jumping doesn't prove too much of an issue.

  1. DUNKERQUE (DEN)
  2. SAMUEL SPADE (GER)
  3. KRAK (FR)

races.name: Happy Birthday Sue Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GLENMALURE FLYER is worth another chance to build on her impressive stable debut success at Bangor. Hat-trick seeking Yes And Yes was thriving when last seen in the spring and has to be respected.

  1. GLENMALURE FLYER (IRE)
  2. YES AND YES (IRE)
  3. ILLOGICAL LOGIC (FR)

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Dan Skelton has enjoyed plenty of success with new recruits this summer and BERRY EDGE looks another likely type. He's narrowly preferred to Jet Patrol, who won this corresponding race 12 months ago, with Reteti also considered on the strength of his recent form.

  1. BERRY EDGE (IRE)
  2. JET PATROL (IRE)
  3. RETETI
